4797.title: ACP bridge ignores updated per-prompt permission settings
4797.rootCauseOneLine: ACP turn/start retains startup policy and writable roots; turn/steer drops execution options from the queue, so both paths enforce obsolete permissions.

prReviews.verdict: STATIC ONLY — closed and unmerged; not acceptance-verified
prReviews.topFinding: The diff targets the measured option-loss and policy-refresh omissions; native restart, real-agent cancellation, and logical-turn continuity were not verified.

4797.proposedFix: Apply validated execution options before every ACP prompt, retain options with queued inputs, update the in-memory policy without restarting when possible, and handle native-flag restarts without splitting the logical turn.
4797.caveats: Two clean trusted-main runs each produced 8 failing transitions and 8 passing unchanged-policy controls. The reproduction uses the repository's stdio ACP fixture and real bridge, not a third-party ACP agent. No automatic fix is permitted because this changes a permission/security boundary.
